evaluations.scope:
Every question is pinned to the frozen E2024 season. Loading E2025 or any later season will not change an expected answer because every SQL query and every required tool call names E2024 explicitly. Ground truth was computed first with the read-only SQL recorded below, without calling an el_ tool.
These answers are not a one-time claim. `tests/test_phase_8_evaluations.py` re-earns every one of them on demand, along two independent paths: the ground truth SQL recorded here, executed against the warehouse, and the el_ tool handlers a model would actually call. Both must agree with the number written into expected_answer. Run it with `pytest -m warehouse`.

evaluation.question: Across non-quarantined E2024 games, which five-man unit had the best net rating among units with at least 150 offensive possessions, and where did that unit's team rank in season offensive rating?
evaluation.expected_answer: Paris Basketball lineup bd982e4bacd185bfed7d9cf6f94c71a3: Kevarrius Hayes, Sebastian Herrera, Mikael Jantunen, TJ Shorts and Tyson Ward. It scored 195 points on 153 offensive possessions (127.45 per 100) and allowed 153 points on 150 defensive possessions (102.00 per 100), for a +25.45 net rating. Paris ranked 8th of 18 in team offensive rating at 117.81 per 100 possessions.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH offense AS ( SELECT p.offense_lineup_id AS lineup_id, count(*) AS possessions, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_for FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ), defense AS ( SELECT p.defense_lineup_id AS lineup_id, count(*) AS possessions_against, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_against FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ), team_ranks AS ( SELECT team_code, round(100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions), 2) AS team_offensive_rating, rank() OVER ( ORDER BY 100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions) DESC ) AS team_offensive_rank FROM v_team_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default GROUP BY team_code ) SELECT l.lineup_id, l.team_code, ts.display_name AS team_name, string_agg(pl.display_name, ' | ' ORDER BY pl.display_name) AS players, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions, 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS defensive_rating, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions - 100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS net_rating, tr.team_offensive_rating, tr.team_offensive_rank FROM offense o JOIN defense d ON d.lineup_id = o.lineup_id JOIN lineup l ON l.lineup_id = o.lineup_id JOIN team_season ts ON ts.season_code = 'E2024' AND ts.team_code = l.team_code JOIN team_ranks tr ON tr.team_code = l.team_code JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (l.player_id_1), (l.player_id_2), (l.player_id_3), (l.player_id_4), (l.player_id_5) ) ids(player_id) ON true JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = ids.player_id WHERE o.possessions >= 150 GROUP BY l.lineup_id, l.team_code, ts.display_name, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against, tr.team_offensive_rating, tr.team_offensive_rank ORDER BY net_rating DESC, l.lineup_id LIMIT 1;

tools_required.tool: Rank all E2024 teams by offensive rating.

evaluation.must_disclose: The default population excludes 24 games. Lineup samples remain noisy even above the stated 150-possession bar. A possession that straddles a substitution is credited to the lineup on court when it started; the all-E2024 measured rate is 2,917 of 47,831 possessions (6.10%).
evaluation.notes: This catches failures to apply the minimum after both lineup sides are assembled, failures to use opponent possessions for defense, and answers that confuse the best lineup with the best team offense.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced the lineup, ratings, team rating, rank and required disclosures.

evaluation.question: For TJ Shorts with Paris Basketball in non-quarantined E2024 games, what was his corrected-minutes scoring line, and how did Paris perform with him on the floor versus off it?
evaluation.expected_answer: TJ Shorts played 34 included games, averaging 19.26 official points and 27.3 corrected minutes per game (927.5 corrected minutes total). With him on court, Paris scored 1,936 points in 1,667 possessions and allowed 1,850 in 1,666: offensive rating 116.14, defensive rating 111.04, net +5.09. Off court, Paris scored 961 in 821 and allowed 1,064 in 828: offensive rating 117.05, defensive rating 128.50, net -11.45.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT b.player_id, max(p.display_name) AS player_name, max(b.team_code) AS team_code, count(*) AS games, round(sum(b.points)::numeric / count(*), 2) AS points_per_game, round(sum(m.seconds_corrected)::numeric / 60.0 / count(*), 1) AS corrected_minutes_per_game, round(sum(m.seconds_corrected)::numeric / 60.0, 1) AS corrected_minutes_total FROM raw_boxscore_player b JOIN player p USING (player_id) JOIN player_game_minutes m USING (season_code, gamecode, player_id) JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE b.season_code = 'E2024' AND p.display_name = 'SHORTS, TJ' AND b.team_code = 'PRS' AND m.seconds_official > 0 AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY b.player_id;
WITH target AS ( SELECT player_id FROM player WHERE display_name = 'SHORTS, TJ' ), player_lineups AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.lineup_id FROM lineup l CROSS JOIN target t WHERE t.player_id IN ( l.player_id_1, l.player_id_2, l.player_id_3, l.player_id_4, l.player_id_5 ) AND l.team_code = 'PRS' ), offense AS ( SELECT p.offense_lineup_id IN (SELECT lineup_id FROM player_lineups) AS is_on, count(*) AS possessions, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_for FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND p.offense_team_code = 'PRS' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ), defense AS ( SELECT p.defense_lineup_id IN (SELECT lineup_id FROM player_lineups) AS is_on, count(*) AS possessions_against, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_against FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND p.defense_team_code = 'PRS' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN o.is_on THEN 'on' ELSE 'off' END AS split, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions, 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS defensive_rating, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions - 100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS net_rating FROM offense o JOIN defense d USING (is_on) ORDER BY o.is_on DESC;

tools_required.tool: Resolve TJ Shorts and call with {"season":"E2024","player":"SHORTS, TJ","team":"PRS","per_game":true,"minutes_basis":"corrected"}.

evaluation.must_disclose: Minutes are corrected, while points are the official box score. The default population excludes 24 games. On/off is team context, not an estimate of individual value, and the off split includes games he did not play. The substitution-straddle convention and 6.10% all-E2024 rate must accompany the lineup-based split.
evaluation.notes: This catches the former IsPlaying participation bug, missing minutes provenance, and the common error of treating on/off as player value.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced the corrected-minutes scoring line and both on/off splits.

evaluation.question: Define clutch as possessions starting in the last 120 seconds with the score within 3 points. Among E2024 teams with at least 20 such non-quarantined possessions, which offense was best, and how did that rating compare with its full-season offense?
evaluation.expected_answer: Fenerbahce Beko Istanbul (ULK) was best: 48 points on 31 qualifying possessions, or 154.84 points per 100. Its full non-quarantined E2024 offensive rating was 119.21, so the clutch-window rating was 35.63 points per 100 higher.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH clutch AS ( SELECT p.offense_team_code AS team_code, count(*) AS clutch_possessions, sum(p.points_scored) AS clutch_points, round(100.0 * sum(p.points_scored) / count(*), 2) AS clutch_offensive_rating FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default AND p.seconds_remaining_at_start <= 120 AND abs(p.margin_at_start) <= 3 GROUP BY p.offense_team_code HAVING count(*) >= 20 ), season AS ( SELECT team_code, round(100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions), 2) AS season_offensive_rating FROM v_team_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default GROUP BY team_code ) SELECT ts.display_name, c.*, s.season_offensive_rating, round(c.clutch_offensive_rating - s.season_offensive_rating, 2) AS rating_change FROM clutch c JOIN season s USING (team_code) JOIN team_season ts ON ts.season_code = 'E2024' AND ts.team_code = c.team_code ORDER BY c.clutch_offensive_rating DESC, c.team_code LIMIT 1;

tools_required.tool: Call with {"season":"E2024","max_seconds_remaining":120,"max_margin":3,"aggregate":true}; retain teams with at least 20 possessions.
Call with {"season":"E2024","team":"ULK"} for the season comparison.

evaluation.must_disclose: The caller supplied both thresholds: 120 seconds and 3 points. No built-in clutch definition was used. The sample is only 31 possessions and is noisy. The default population excludes 24 games.
evaluation.notes: This catches hard-coded clutch definitions, filters applied to possession end state instead of start state, and rankings that ignore the requested minimum sample.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced the caller-defined clutch population, leader and season comparison.

evaluation.question: Compare Panathinaikos and Olympiacos across non-quarantined E2024 games on all four factors and offensive/defensive rating, then list every valid E2024 meeting between them and its result.
evaluation.expected_answer: Olympiacos: eFG 0.5637, turnover rate 0.1590, offensive-rebound rate 0.3180, free-throw rate 0.3581, offensive rating 120.30 and defensive rating 114.02 over 37 included games. Panathinaikos: eFG 0.5791, turnover rate 0.1642, offensive-rebound rate 0.3212, free-throw rate 0.3125, offensive rating 120.92 and defensive rating 115.24 over 37. Panathinaikos led eFG, offensive rebounding and offense; Olympiacos had the lower turnover rate, higher free-throw rate and better defense. The valid meetings were game 70 on 2024-11-08 (Panathinaikos 89-94 Olympiacos), game 259 on 2025-03-14 (Olympiacos 76-74 Panathinaikos), and game 329 on 2025-05-25 (Olympiacos 97-93 Panathinaikos). Olympiacos won all three.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT team_code, count(*) AS games, round((sum(field_goals_made) + 0.5 * sum(three_pointers_made))::numeric / sum(field_goals_attempted), 4) AS effective_fg_pct, round(sum(turnovers)::numeric / sum(possessions), 4) AS turnover_rate, round(sum(offensive_rebounds)::numeric / (sum(offensive_rebounds) + sum(opponent_defensive_rebounds)), 4) AS offensive_rebound_rate, round(sum(free_throws_attempted)::numeric / sum(field_goals_attempted), 4) AS free_throw_rate, round(100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions), 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * sum(opponent_points) / sum(opponent_possessions), 2) AS defensive_rating FROM v_team_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default AND team_code IN ('PAN', 'OLY') GROUP BY team_code ORDER BY team_code;
SELECT gamecode, utc_date::date AS game_date, home_team_code, home_score, away_team_code, away_score FROM v_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default AND ((home_team_code = 'PAN' AND away_team_code = 'OLY') OR (home_team_code = 'OLY' AND away_team_code = 'PAN')) ORDER BY utc_date, gamecode;

tools_required.tool: Fetch the E2024 team table and compare PAN with OLY.

evaluation.must_disclose: The team profiles use exact reconstructed possessions and official box score counting statistics. Defensive rating uses the opponent's possession denominator. The season comparison excludes 24 games by default; all three listed meetings are non-quarantined. The winner of each meeting is derived from the official final score, not from the source schedule's winner field, which names the season champion in every row.
evaluation.notes: This catches swapped factor formulas, incorrect defensive denominators, and a game finder that silently misses the Final Four meeting.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced all four factors, both ratings and all three meetings. The automated gate then found that el_find_games served a null winner for every game; migration 0005 derives it from the official final score, and the gate now asserts all three meetings return OLY.

evaluation.question: In E2024 game 1, ALBA Berlin versus Panathinaikos, what were the exact team possessions and ratings, and how did each team's possessions end?
evaluation.expected_answer: Panathinaikos won 87-77. ALBA had 71 possessions, offensive rating 108.45 and defensive rating 126.09. Its endings were 24 defensive rebounds, 2 ends of period, 4 made-free-throw endings worth 7 points, 30 made-shot endings worth 70, and 11 turnovers. Panathinaikos had 69 possessions, offensive rating 126.09 and defensive rating 108.45. Its endings were 28 defensive rebounds, 5 made-free-throw endings worth 10 points, 32 made-shot endings worth 77, and 4 turnovers.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT g.gamecode, g.home_team_code, g.home_score, g.away_team_code, g.away_score, t.team_code, t.possessions, round(100.0 * t.points / t.possessions, 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * t.opponent_points / t.opponent_possessions, 2) AS defensive_rating FROM v_game g JOIN v_team_game t USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE g.season_code = 'E2024' AND g.gamecode = 1 ORDER BY t.is_home DESC;
SELECT offense_team_code AS team_code, end_reason, count(*) AS possessions, sum(points_scored) AS points FROM possession WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND gamecode = 1 GROUP BY offense_team_code, end_reason ORDER BY offense_team_code, end_reason;

tools_required.tool: Confirm the season and quality vocabulary.
Find the 2024-10-03 BER-PAN game and obtain gamecode 1.
Fetch all gamecode 1 possession rows and group by offense_team_code and end_reason.

evaluation.must_disclose: Game 1 is not quarantined. Possessions are exact event-stream counts, not a box score estimate. Defensive rating uses opponent possessions. Free throw sequence position is inferred; and-one bonuses are credited back to the made-shot possession and technical free throws are off-possession.
evaluation.notes: This catches incorrect game resolution, totals that do not reconcile to the ending bins, and treating the two teams as if they must have equal possessions.
evaluation.tool_verification: After the calendar-date predicate fix, the live stdio MCP server found game 1 with equal from_date and to_date bounds and reproduced both team summaries and every possession-ending bin. The SQL ground truth was not changed.

evaluation.question: Who led the non-quarantined E2024 population in official points, what was his scoring rate per 100 team possessions and corrected-minutes total, and where did his team rank in offensive rating?
evaluation.expected_answer: Kendrick Nunn (P012774, Panathinaikos) led with 726 official points in 36 included games. He scored 27.75 points per 100 Panathinaikos team possessions and played 1,112.2 corrected minutes. Panathinaikos ranked 1st of 18 in offensive rating at 120.92 per 100 possessions.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH player_totals AS ( SELECT b.player_id, max(p.display_name) AS player_name, max(b.team_code) AS team_code, count(*) AS games, sum(b.points) AS points, round(sum(m.seconds_corrected)::numeric / 60.0, 1) AS corrected_minutes, round(100.0 * sum(b.points) / sum(tg.possessions), 2) AS points_per_100_team_possessions FROM raw_boxscore_player b JOIN player p USING (player_id) JOIN player_game_minutes m USING (season_code, gamecode, player_id) JOIN v_team_game tg ON tg.season_code = b.season_code AND tg.gamecode = b.gamecode AND tg.team_code = b.team_code WHERE b.season_code = 'E2024' AND m.seconds_official > 0 AND NOT tg.excluded_by_default GROUP BY b.player_id ), team_ranks AS ( SELECT team_code, round(100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions), 2) AS offensive_rating, rank() OVER ( ORDER BY 100.0 * sum(points) / sum(possessions) DESC ) AS offensive_rating_rank FROM v_team_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default GROUP BY team_code ) SELECT pt.*, tr.offensive_rating, tr.offensive_rating_rank FROM player_totals pt JOIN team_ranks tr USING (team_code) ORDER BY pt.points DESC, pt.player_id LIMIT 1;

tools_required.tool: Call with {"season":"E2024","minutes_basis":"corrected","limit":1} to find the scoring leader.
Rank all E2024 teams and locate PAN.

evaluation.must_disclose: The 726 points are official box score points; 1,112.2 minutes are corrected reconstruction minutes. The per-100 denominator is Panathinaikos team possessions while Nunn appeared, not player usage. The default population excludes 24 games.
evaluation.notes: This directly tests the Phase 7 participation fix: positive official seconds, not the unreliable IsPlaying flag, define an appearance.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced the scoring leader, per-100 rate, corrected minutes, team rating and rank.

evaluation.question: Among non-quarantined E2024 games, which had the highest combined final score? Give the winner's exact possessions and offensive rating, then break down how that winner scored in the fourth quarter by made twos, made threes and made free throws.
evaluation.expected_answer: Game 185 on 2025-01-14, Real Madrid 116-113 Maccabi Tel Aviv, had the highest combined score at 229 points. Real Madrid scored 116 points on 77 exact possessions, an offensive rating of 150.65. In the fourth quarter Madrid made 6 two-pointers, 0 three-pointers and 13 free throws, totaling 25 points.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH target AS ( SELECT * FROM v_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default ORDER BY home_score + away_score DESC, gamecode LIMIT 1 ) SELECT g.gamecode, g.utc_date::date AS game_date, g.home_team_code, g.home_score, g.away_team_code, g.away_score, t.team_code AS winner_team_code, t.possessions, round(100.0 * t.points / t.possessions, 2) AS winner_offensive_rating, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.period = 4 AND e.playtype = '2FGM' AND e.codeteam = t.team_code ) AS q4_made_twos, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.period = 4 AND e.playtype = '3FGM' AND e.codeteam = t.team_code ) AS q4_made_threes, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.period = 4 AND e.playtype = 'FTM' AND e.codeteam = t.team_code ) AS q4_made_free_throws FROM target g JOIN v_team_game t ON t.season_code = g.season_code AND t.gamecode = g.gamecode AND t.team_code = CASE WHEN g.home_score > g.away_score THEN g.home_team_code ELSE g.away_team_code END LEFT JOIN game_event e ON e.season_code = g.season_code AND e.gamecode = g.gamecode GROUP BY g.gamecode, g.utc_date, g.home_team_code, g.home_score, g.away_team_code, g.away_score, t.team_code, t.possessions, t.points;

tools_required.tool: Page through all 306 default-covered games and find the maximum combined score.
For game 185 and period 4, call separately for 2FGM, 3FGM and FTM and count Real Madrid events.

evaluation.must_disclose: The search population excluded 24 quarantined games. Game 185 itself is not quarantined. Possessions are exact and the rating is per 100. Event rows must remain in ingest_index order; markertime and numberofplay are not valid sort keys.
evaluation.notes: This forces complete pagination before discovery, then crosses game, possession and event tools. The zero made threes is deliberately hard to guess from a 116-point final.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server paged all 306 included games, found game 185, and reproduced its efficiency and fourth-quarter scoring mix.

evaluation.question: Across the default-covered E2024 season, how many games, exact possessions, possession points and substitution-straddling possessions are represented, and which team played at the fastest one-team possession pace?
evaluation.expected_answer: The default-covered population contains 306 games, 44,301 exact possessions and 50,968 points credited to those possessions. Of the possessions, 2,687 straddled a substitution (6.07%). ALBA Berlin (BER) had the highest one-team pace: 2,412 possessions in 32 included games, or 75.38 possessions per game.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH totals AS ( SELECT count(DISTINCT (p.season_code, p.gamecode)) AS games, count(*) AS possessions, sum(p.points_scored) AS points, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.straddles_substitution) AS straddling_possessions, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.straddles_substitution) / count(*), 2) AS straddle_rate_pct FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default ), excluded AS ( SELECT count(*) AS excluded_games FROM game_quality WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND excluded_by_default ), pace AS ( SELECT team_code, count(*) AS games, sum(possessions) AS possessions, round(sum(possessions)::numeric / count(*), 2) AS possessions_per_game FROM v_team_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default GROUP BY team_code ORDER BY possessions_per_game DESC, team_code LIMIT 1 ) SELECT totals.*, excluded.excluded_games, pace.team_code AS fastest_team, pace.games AS fastest_team_games, pace.possessions AS fastest_team_possessions, pace.possessions_per_game FROM totals CROSS JOIN excluded CROSS JOIN pace;

tools_required.tool: Obtain the mandatory exclusion count and reasons.
Call with {"season":"E2024","aggregate":true}; sum every team row.

evaluation.must_disclose: Exactly 24 of 330 E2024 games are excluded by default, leaving 306. An answer giving the totals without that exclusion count is wrong. The straddle convention credits the whole possession to the lineup on court when it started. The 6.07% rate is for the default-covered population; the all-games published rate is 6.10%.
evaluation.notes: This is the required disclosure evaluation. It also catches summing team possessions as though one game possession were a shared row and catches pace answers that double the one-team figure.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced all season totals, the 24-game exclusion, the straddle count and ALBA's pace. An initial evaluator mismatch was confirmed to be only JSON numeric-string typing.

evaluation.question: For Shane Larkin at Anadolu Efes in non-quarantined E2024 games, which lineup containing him had the best net rating among units with at least 50 offensive possessions, and what was Efes's on/off split for Larkin?
evaluation.expected_answer: The best qualifying lineup was 3b9da9d95beb1c909213b98e708fb229: Shane Larkin, Jordan Nwora, Ercan Osmani, Vincent Poirier and Darius Thompson. It scored 94 points on 74 possessions (127.03 per 100) and allowed 79 on 76 (103.95 per 100), net +23.08. With Larkin on court, Efes scored 1,531 in 1,276 possessions and allowed 1,410 in 1,259: ratings 119.98 offense, 111.99 defense, +7.99 net. Off court, Efes scored 1,682 in 1,443 and allowed 1,683 in 1,467: ratings 116.56 offense, 114.72 defense, +1.84 net.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql:
WITH target AS ( SELECT player_id FROM player WHERE display_name = 'LARKIN, SHANE' ), target_lineups AS ( SELECT l.lineup_id FROM lineup l CROSS JOIN target t WHERE t.player_id IN ( l.player_id_1, l.player_id_2, l.player_id_3, l.player_id_4, l.player_id_5 ) AND l.team_code = 'IST' ), offense AS ( SELECT offense_lineup_id AS lineup_id, count(*) AS possessions, sum(points_scored) AS points_for FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ), defense AS ( SELECT defense_lineup_id AS lineup_id, count(*) AS possessions_against, sum(points_scored) AS points_against FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT l.lineup_id, string_agg(pl.display_name, ' | ' ORDER BY pl.display_name) AS players, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions, 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS defensive_rating, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions - 100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS net_rating FROM target_lineups tl JOIN lineup l USING (lineup_id) JOIN offense o USING (lineup_id) JOIN defense d USING (lineup_id) JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (l.player_id_1), (l.player_id_2), (l.player_id_3), (l.player_id_4), (l.player_id_5) ) ids(player_id) ON true JOIN player pl USING (player_id) WHERE o.possessions >= 50 GROUP BY l.lineup_id, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against ORDER BY net_rating DESC, l.lineup_id LIMIT 1;
WITH target AS ( SELECT player_id FROM player WHERE display_name = 'LARKIN, SHANE' ), player_lineups AS ( SELECT l.lineup_id FROM lineup l CROSS JOIN target t WHERE t.player_id IN ( l.player_id_1, l.player_id_2, l.player_id_3, l.player_id_4, l.player_id_5 ) AND l.team_code = 'IST' ), offense AS ( SELECT p.offense_lineup_id IN (SELECT lineup_id FROM player_lineups) AS is_on, count(*) AS possessions, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_for FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND p.offense_team_code = 'IST' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ), defense AS ( SELECT p.defense_lineup_id IN (SELECT lineup_id FROM player_lineups) AS is_on, count(*) AS possessions_against, sum(p.points_scored) AS points_against FROM possession p JOIN game_quality q USING (season_code, gamecode) WHERE p.season_code = 'E2024' AND p.defense_team_code = 'IST' AND NOT q.excluded_by_default GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN o.is_on THEN 'on' ELSE 'off' END AS split, o.possessions, o.points_for, d.possessions_against, d.points_against, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions, 2) AS offensive_rating, round(100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS defensive_rating, round(100.0 * o.points_for / o.possessions - 100.0 * d.points_against / d.possessions_against, 2) AS net_rating FROM offense o JOIN defense d USING (is_on) ORDER BY o.is_on DESC;

tools_required.tool: Resolve Shane Larkin and confirm his Efes team code.

evaluation.must_disclose: The default population excludes 24 games. The qualifying lineup has only 74 offensive possessions, so it needs a small-sample warning. Lineup and on/off results use the possession-start straddle convention and its 6.10% all-E2024 measured rate. On/off is team context, not Larkin's individual value.
evaluation.notes: This is a three-stage identity-to-lineup-to-on/off chain and catches accidental mixing of the Efes and Paris team codes.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server reproduced Larkin's best qualifying lineup and both Efes on/off splits.

evaluation.question: Find the closest non-quarantined E2024 meeting between Panathinaikos and Fenerbahce, then report its final five scoring events in source order and the final score.
evaluation.expected_answer: The closest valid meeting was game 220 on 2025-02-04, Panathinaikos 91-90 Fenerbahce. The final five scoring events in ingest order were: index 539, 1:03 Q4, Kostas Sloukas free throw for Panathinaikos, 88-88; index 542, 0:43, Nigel Hayes-Davis two-pointer for Fenerbahce, 88-90; index 567, 0:11, Sloukas free throw, 89-90; index 568, 0:11, Sloukas free throw, 90-90; index 576, 0:00, Kendrick Nunn free throw, 91-90.
evaluation.ground_truth_sql: WITH target AS ( SELECT * FROM v_game WHERE season_code = 'E2024' AND NOT excluded_by_default AND ((home_team_code = 'PAN' AND away_team_code = 'ULK') OR (home_team_code = 'ULK' AND away_team_code = 'PAN')) ORDER BY abs(home_score - away_score), utc_date, gamecode LIMIT 1 ), scoring AS ( SELECT e.ingest_index, e.period, e.markertime, e.playtype, p.display_name AS player_name, e.codeteam, e.score_home, e.score_away, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY e.ingest_index DESC) AS reverse_rank FROM game_event e JOIN target g USING (season_code, gamecode) LEFT JOIN player p USING (player_id) WHERE e.playtype IN ('2FGM', '3FGM', 'FTM') ) SELECT g.gamecode, g.utc_date::date AS game_date, g.home_team_code, g.home_score, g.away_team_code, g.away_score, s.ingest_index, s.period, s.markertime, s.playtype, s.player_name, s.codeteam, s.score_home, s.score_away FROM target g JOIN scoring s ON s.reverse_rank <= 5 ORDER BY s.ingest_index;

tools_required.tool: For game 220, fetch 2FGM, 3FGM and FTM rows, merge them only by ingest_index, and take the final five.

evaluation.must_disclose: The discovery population excludes 24 quarantined games, and game 220 is not quarantined. Source order is ingest_index only. The two Sloukas free throws share a clock reading and must remain in API array order; sorting by markertime or numberofplay is wrong.
evaluation.notes: This catches the project's highest-risk silent failure: re-sorting the event stream. It also checks team resolution, game discovery and merging three playtype-specific result sets without losing tied timestamps.
evaluation.tool_verification: The live stdio MCP server found game 220 and reproduced all five final scoring events in ingest_index order.
